主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. (Nasdaq, NICK) announced on February 19, 2013, that its Board of Directors had declared a cash dividend of $0.12 per share on its common stock. The dividend is scheduled to be paid on March 29, 2013, to shareholders of record as of March 22, 2013. The announcement was made in conjunction with a press release dated February 19, 2013. The company is based in Clearwater, Florida, and its headquarters are located at 2454 McMullen Booth Road, Building C. The filing was submitted under Form 8-K to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
